facts.fact: BoFiNet launched the carrier-neutral Digital Delta Data Centre in Gaborone in the week of the article, a ceremony attended by the Minister of Communications and Innovation.
The Uptime Institute awarded the Digital Delta Data Centre (BoFiNet, Gaborone) Tier III Certification of Constructed Facility in October 2025, per BoFiNet's acting CEO.
